arm-A.title: The Agents seize Neo at the office
arm-A.summary: A routine package delivers a ringing phone and Morpheus's warning that forces are closing in, and the abstract threat becomes a real raid. Guided turn-by-turn by Morpheus's voice, Neo moves across the office floor — into an empty cubicle, down a row, into a first office on the left — and slips past the searching Agents to the base of the skyscraper, only to be driven to a window ledge he cannot bring himself to cross. When his nerve breaks and he climbs back inside, the way out is gone; a female employee points out his position, and the Agents take him, handcuffed and forced into a dark sedan.
arm-A.action: The Agents seize Neo at the office and take him into custody, after his Morpheus-guided escape through the office floor ends in a failed crossing he cannot complete.

state_triples.reading: Neo acts throughout on a trust he cannot justify — he obeys a voice that has been hunting him through messages because the alternative, staying to learn what 'they' will do, is worse. His body follows each command even as his mind protests, and the whole sequence is a test of whether he can believe enough to be led. The ledge is where that faith breaks: he will risk the impossible only until the environment makes the danger feel real

state_triples.reading: Smith moves through the office as though the outcome is already decided — he enters Neo's cubicle himself rather than delegate, because he does not conceive of a way out of a sealed floor. That certainty is exactly what Neo exploits to get behind him, but it costs Smith nothing: his patience and his net are large enough that one evasion changes nothing. He is conducting, not chasing, and the capture at the end is the vindication of that composure rather than a relief.

Trinity's single curse is the measure of how much rests on Neo's escape — she is placed exactly where she can see it fail. Her dismay is not surprise at the raid but at its outcome: the man she has been steering toward the truth has been taken, and she can do nothing but witness it. The restraint of the reaction — one word, seen in a mirror

Her single gesture — turning and pointing out Neo's cubicle the instant the Agents arrive — is legible to everyone in the room but her own motive stays hidden, and that ambiguity is the whole point. She may be a knowing collaborator handing Neo over, or simply a startled coworker redirecting a frightening commotion toward its source; the scene refuses to decide, and so does Neo, who cannot tell whether he has been incidentally exposed or deliberately betrayed.

Morpheus guides with the calm of someone who has been waiting for this moment and means to use it — he tests Neo's readiness even in the middle of a raid, withholding explanation ('The answer is coming') and refusing to soothe beyond the facts. At the ledge he does not command; he lays out the two ways out and hands Neo the choice, then hangs up, because he believes fear, not incapacity

The phone is Neo's only tether to the one person trying to get him out, and its fall is the event's quiet turning point: from the moment it rings at his desk it is his lifeline, clutched through every command, and when the wind knocks it from his hand on the ledge he loses not just his balance but his guide. Its loss is what leaves him alone to decide — and alone to fail.

arm-B.title: The Agents seize Neo at the office
arm-B.summary: A phone reaches Neo's cubicle and Morpheus, on the line, warns that forces are closing in and will not say what they intend. Neo sees Agent Smith leading cops onto the floor and a female employee pointing out his cubicle, and he follows Morpheus's instructions out of the row and into an empty office. Morpheus directs him out to a ledge from which he can reach the roof; Neo commits, but his nerve breaks when the wind blasts him and the phone falls from his grip just as a cop opens the door, and he climbs back inside into the hands of the waiting cop. He is seized, handcuffed, and forced into a dark sedan in the Agents' custody. Trinity, watching from her motorcycle, sees him taken and knows the extraction has failed.
arm-B.action: The event folds a raid, a guided escape, and a failed leap into one motion. Neo is converted from a recipient of messages into a fugitive and then into a prisoner: guided out of the cubicle, out to the window ledge, and back inside into Agent Smith's custody. Morpheus's remote guidance gets him out of the row but cannot steady his body at the ledge, and the dropped phone severs his only link to that guidance at the moment he most needs it. The one exit he could not bring himself to take is the only one that would have kept him free.
